newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese news agency workers start strike.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese news agency workers start strike.

text.p: Journalists, technicians and administrative staff at Portugal's Lusa news agency began a four-day strike on Thursday to press salary demands, a union spokesman said.
"We are striking to press for increases in salaries promised by management in 1995 and again in March 1996, which did not materialise," Mario Silva told Reuters.
He said at least 90 percent of Lusa's 180 journalists, including some foreign correspondents, had stopped work.
The economic news section in Lisbon and the Macau office were operating, he added.
No formal talks were taking place with management over the salary demands, Silva said.
Lusa, a cooperative financed mainly by the state, serves media clients in Portugal and former Portuguese colonies in Africa.
